title: Table 78. WLCSP49 recommended PCB design rules (0.4 mm pitch)
text_helper: Table 78. WLCSP49 recommended PCB design rules (0.4 mm pitch) — section 7 Package information. Dimension, Recommended values.

rows: Non-solder mask defined via underbump allowed.
notes: 1. Parts marked as “ES”, “E” or accompanied by an Engineering Sample notification letter, are not yet qualified and therefore not approved for use in production. ST is not responsible for any consequences
2. All leads/pads should also be soldered to the PCB to improve the lead/pad solder joint life.
3. There is an exposed die pad on the underside of the UFQFPN48 package. It is recommended to connect and solder this back-side pad to PCB ground.
